description: This file defines the Axis class within the PhpSpreadsheet Chart namespace, managing various chart axis properties such as gridlines, axis type, options, fill color, and other configurations essential for chart rendering.

classes.name: Axis
classes.description: Represents a chart axis with configurable properties such as gridlines, type, options, fill color, and orientation, used in generating and customizing spreadsheet charts.

methods.name: setAxisNumberProperties
methods.description: Sets properties for the axis number format, including format code, whether it is numeric, and if it's source-linked.

methods.name: getAxisNumberFormat
methods.description: Returns the format code of the axis number format.

methods.name: getAxisNumberSourceLinked
methods.description: Returns whether the axis number is linked to a source.

methods.name: getAxisIsNumericFormat
methods.description: Determines if the axis is using a numeric format based on axis type or numeric flag.

methods.name: setAxisOption
methods.description: Sets a specific axis option property identified by key.

methods.name: setAxisOptionsProperties
methods.description: Bulk sets multiple axis options including labels, cross point, orientation, tick marks, bounds, units, and rotation.

methods.name: getAxisOptionsProperty
methods.description: Retrieves specific axis option properties, including calculating rotation if axis text is present.

methods.name: setAxisOrientation
methods.description: Sets the orientation of the axis.

methods.name: getAxisType
methods.description: Returns the current type of the axis.

methods.name: setAxisType
methods.description: Sets the axis type, ensuring it is one of category, value, or date.

methods.name: setFillParameters
methods.description: Configures the fill color for the axis with optional transparency.

methods.name: getFillProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a fill property by key.

methods.name: getFillColorObject
methods.description: Returns the ChartColor object associated with this axis.

methods.name: getLineProperty
methods.description: Deprecated: Retrieves line color property, use getLineColorProperty in Properties class instead.

methods.name: setCrossBetween
methods.description: Sets the cross between property for the axis.

methods.name: getCrossBetween
methods.description: Gets the cross between property value.

methods.name: getMajorGridlines
methods.description: Returns the major gridlines object, if set.

methods.name: getMinorGridlines
methods.description: Returns the minor gridlines object, if set.

methods.name: setMajorGridlines
methods.description: Sets the major gridlines for the axis.

methods.name: setMinorGridlines
methods.description: Sets the minor gridlines for the axis.

methods.name: getAxisText
methods.description: Returns the AxisText object controlling axis label text.

methods.name: setAxisText
methods.description: Sets the AxisText object for axis labels.

methods.name: setNoFill
methods.description: Sets whether the axis should have no fill.

methods.name: getNoFill
methods.description: Returns whether the axis has no fill.
